openQuestions.q: Should Story-dispatch Envelope omit reviewRunId/reviewRound while review-run Envelope requires them?
openQuestions.evidence: The updated plan correctly makes agent_prompt Story-dispatch audit-only and accepts only role/storyId/format, but CHK-001 full-envelope-contract-complete requires reviewRunId for every Story 2 envelope and CHK-002 agent-prompt-story-full-assembly promises ReviewRun bindings. These cannot both hold for an audit-only story-dispatch Envelope.

openQuestions.q: Does a provider retry mint a fresh attemptId under the stable ledgerCallId, or preserve one attemptId?
openQuestions.evidence: Current runtime smoke and the updated plan/understanding/decision say mintRetryAttempt keeps ledgerCallId and creates a fresh attemptId, while CHK-003 context/userSees and two verification intents require a stable existing attemptId. Operational rules say current runtime facts override stale planning prose.

openQuestions.q: Should a newer same-lane ReviewRun invalidate an older same-round pass solely by ID recency?
openQuestions.evidence: CHK-003 review-run-restart-invalidates-prior-envelope and milestone M3 say yes, but the accepted review-run-binding-race decision and current flow-stability smoke require a non-latest pass to remain admissible when material and scope are fresh; only cross-run substitution or true freshness drift should fail.
